body.introPara: At Develo Design, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring you have a positive experience on our website. This Privacy and Cookies Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
body.collectIntro: We collect information in the following ways:
body.collectProvidedPara: When you contact us through forms or communications, we collect information such as your name, email address, phone number, company details, and any other information you choose to provide.
body.collectAutoPara: We automatically collect certain information about your device and how you interact with our website, including IP address, browser type, pages visited, and time spent on pages.
body.collectCookiesPara: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience. See our Cookies Policy section below for more details.
body.useIntro: We use the information we collect to:
body.useItem1: Respond to your inquiries and provide customer support
body.useItem2: Send you requested information about our services
body.securityPara: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is completely secure.
body.cookiesIntro: We use cookies to improve your experience on our website. Cookies are small files stored on your device that help us remember your preferences and understand how you use our site.
body.cookiesAnalyticsDesc: Help us understand how you use our site
body.cookiesMarketingDesc: Used to deliver relevant content and advertisements
body.cookiesManagePara: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to refuse cookies or alert you when a cookie is being sent.
body.thirdPartyPara: Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of other websites and encourage you to review their privacy policies.
body.contactPara: If you have questions about this Privacy and Cookies Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us:

contact.pageDescription: Ready to bring your IPL device to market? Get in touch with iShine — your OEM/ODM IPL manufacturing partner in Shenzhen — and we can book a call to discuss your goals, volumes and compliance requirements.

hero.title: Ready to bring your IPL device to market?
hero.description: Great devices start with great conversations. Tell us about your brand, target market and compliance goals — we'll help you turn them into a launch-ready IPL device.

form.auditStrong: Get a free IPL device audit
form.auditText: — Recommendations on energy output, frequency and stability, plus compliance and certification guidance
form.messagePlaceholder: Describe your device concept, target market, volumes and timeline...

item1.question: How do we get started?
item1.answer: The first step is a quick call so we can understand your product concept, target market and volume expectations. It is also a chance for you to see how our OEM/ODM process works, from specification review to sample approval and mass production.

item2.question: What are your minimum order quantities?
item2.answer: We support low minimum order quantities. Our no-MOQ program lets you test the market with small batches first, then scale production as your brand grows — without heavy upfront inventory risk.

item3.question: How long does it take to get a sample?
item3.answer: For existing models, samples ship within 3-5 business days. For custom-designed devices, prototypes typically take 2-4 weeks depending on the complexity of the design, tooling and features.

item4.question: How do we communicate during a project?
item4.answer: You get a dedicated account manager with direct communication through email, WhatsApp or WeChat. We provide regular production updates with photos and video reports so you always know where your project stands.

item5.question: Can we visit your factory?
item5.answer: Yes. We are based in Shenzhen, China, and welcome factory visits. You can walk through our production lines, QC lab and warehouse — most projects begin with a video factory tour, with in-person visits arranged when helpful.

item6.question: How much does an IPL device cost?
